#include "gesummv.h"

void kernel_gesummv(
    double alpha,
    double beta,
    double A[30][30],
    double B[30][30],
    double tmp[30],
    double x[30],
    double y[30]) {
    for (int i = 0; i != 30; ++i) {
        tmp[i] = 0.0;
        y[i] = 0.0;
        for (int j = 0; j != 30; ++j) {
            tmp[i] = tmp[i] + A[i][j] * x[j];
            y[i] = y[i] + B[i][j] * x[j];
        }
        y[i] = alpha * tmp[i] + beta * y[i];
    }
}
